concerns.text: FR-006 requires an audit verifying 'the project title does not contain forbidden First-Principles terminology', and Technical Constraints forbid the term. But the ratified constitution's title is 'Predicting the Elastic Moduli of 2D Materials from First-Principles Calculations' — the exact project title the audit would check. The spec's own requirement is guaranteed to fail against the constitution it must comply with (FR-030). This is the same root cause as the prior kickback (T060c). The spec must state how this is resolved: either the project title is renamed (and the constitution amended per its Versioning procedure), or FR-006's audit target must be redefined to the spec/paper title rather than the constitution title. As written, FR-006 contradicts the constitution.

Problem Statement says 'maintaining a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) within an acceptable range' — 'acceptable range' is never defined anywhere in the spec, while SC-002 defines success only as a ≥10% relative MAPE reduction vs baseline. Constitution Principle VI references a ≤15% MAPE claim. Three different framings of the accuracy target with no reconciliation; pick one measurable statement and use it consistently.
